EGY.note: A rumour-verification tool is not a rule or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: The Cabinet Media Center launched the Chat Egypt platform, which uses AI to analyse text, images and video to detect and verify rumours, with more than 21,000 data entries added and ministries, agencies and governorates uploading their own verified data.

systems.platform: AI rumour monitoring and verification platform

EGY.note: Chat Egypt is a general administration tool, not a sector system.
The document does not say who built the platform or that AI computing or a model is hosted in Egypt.
